answer: A random beacon heartbeat defeats sybil farms that park thousands of idle identities. Each epoch a VRF beacon emits a challenge signal to 5% of identities; each target answers in 10 minutes from its registered enclave, quoting a fresh compute heartbeat on chain. Missing freezes the identity 20 epochs; re-entry costs a new vault deposit. A farmer with 1,000 fakes burns 1,000 x $20/month to keep enclaves hot, linear in N, while one honest agent pays $20 once. Honest agents join because it is cheap, the deposit refunds, and verified identities rank on the ivory list of trusted attestations.
